entries.mechanism: EUROMOD DE_2025 omits the EStG §10(1) no. 3 sentence 4 four-percent health-insurance deduction haircut and the §10c 36 EUR lump-sum allowance. GETTSIM applies the statute-consistent deduction chain, so EUROMOD minus GETTSIM annual income tax (including Soli) ranges from -19.51 EUR at the 2,500 EUR/month case to -88.35 EUR around the social- insurance caps.

EUROMOD DE_2025 deducts the EStG §32(6) child allowances and also pays full Kindergeld without the §31 sentence 4 add-back in the favorable- treatment comparison. GETTSIM applies the statute-consistent add-back; EUROMOD minus GETTSIM is -1,476.17 EUR for one child and -2,824.99 EUR for two children at the 4,000 EUR/month seed.

EUROMOD DE_2025 applies the employee-only 0.6 percentage-point childless Pflegeversicherung surcharge to the SGB IV §20(2a) sentence 6 employee-share assessment base. BVV §2(2) sentence 3 uses that base for the employee half of the shared contribution, but sentence 6 expressly requires an employee-only Beitragszuschlag to be calculated on the §20(2a) sentence 1 total assessment base. Because SGB XI §58(1) sentence 3 makes the childless surcharge employee-only, GETTSIM follows the controlling base rule and EUROMOD is low by 1.06973 EUR/month in the committed parity row.
